newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki bond market trading hours stay unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki bond market trading hours stay unchanged.

text.p: Interbank traders agreed in a meeting on Friday to keep bond market opening hours unchanged, deciding against an earlier suggestion to extend hours to boost international trade.
The bond market will remain open between 1000/0800 GMT and 1600/1400 GMT, they said.
"There was neither the need nor interest in extending trading hours," one senior dealer said.
After-hours trading will still be possible after the close, market sources said.
Foreign exchange trading hours were extended until 1715/1515 GMT from 1600/1400 GMT on October 14.
